checkedAlternates.risk: White chocolate is sold in molded bars like dark and milk chocolate.
checkedAlternates.resolution: White chocolate contains cocoa butter, sugar, and milk solids with zero non-fat cocoa liquor (group-2), unlike cocoa-mass bars (group-4).

checkedAlternates.risk: Cacao nibs and cocoa powder are both unsweetened baking ingredients.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Cacao nibs retain full natural cocoa butter (~50% fat, group-1), whereas cocoa powders are pressed to remove most cocoa butter (group-3).
